title: Analysis plan for the revision of IEEE Access manuscript Access-2026-44676 (MIML benchmark re-examination)
description: Binding pre-registration (analysis plan) for every new analysis in the revision of 'Re-examining the Multi-Instance Multi-Label Benchmark Suite', deposited before any revision experiment produced a number. Includes the plan (v3), the power-analysis script and its output, the original August 2026 pre-registration files, the superseded v2, nine independent reviews of the plan, and SHA-256 checksums.
